concepts.gloss_en: The glory/honor of God (kevod Hashem); divine honor/glory

reason_for_human: All occurrences vocalize as כְּבוֹד ה' and mean the glory/honor of God; the two written forms differ only by the apostrophe marking the abbreviated divine name (same phrase, same word). Every context is divine honor — glory appearing in the cloud (lm2:60), merit of kevod Hashem via teshuvah/silence (lm1:6), and emunah (lm1:24). Note: occ:1455's proof text actually reads כָבוֹד אֱלֹקִי / מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד and occ:1456's snippet is about teshuvah with no literal כבוד, but both sit inside Lesson 6's divine-honor discourse, so I kept them here rather than splitting.
